title: Puckworks shot result (puckworks.shot-result/1)
description: Everything a simulated shot produces, in SI units with unit suffixes; TDS and EY are fractions. The Rust type crates/puckcore/src/shot/result.rs (ShotResult) is the source of truth. Output documents tolerate unknown fields for forward compatibility; fields are only ever added. Every number is finite.

core_version.description: Version of the core that produced the result.

stop_reason.description: Why the shot ended: "beverage_mass", "time", "max_duration" or "choked" (for 5 s the flow stayed below 0.01 mL/s and below a tenth of the flow the program asked for).

shot_time_s.description: Time from pump start to the stop, s.

first_drops_s.description: Time of the first drops at the outlet, s (null if none fell).

beverage_mass_kg.description: Beverage mass in the cup, including the post-stop drip, kg.

drip_mass_kg.description: Beverage mass added by the post-stop drip, kg. Its carrier volume is bounded by retained headspace (legacy) or charged compliance storage; dissolved solute also contributes mass. Zero when the machine vents.

tds.description: Total dissolved solids of the cup, mass fraction.

ey.description: Extraction yield: dissolved solids in the cup / dry dose.

bed_height_m.description: Bed height after dosing and tamping, m.

headspace_m3.description: Headspace volume above the bed, m³.

extracted_fraction.description: Share of the species' extractable content that reached the cup.

Uniformity.description: Mass-weighted statistics of local EY over all bed cells (weights: the dry solid mass of each cell). Local EY counts what has left the particles, so its mean exceeds the cup EY by what is still in the bed liquid.

Series.description: Time series at numerics.output_interval_s spacing, plus the stop and the end of the drip.

pressure_pa.description: Pressure at the top of the bed, Pa (gauge).

flow_in_m3_s.description: Pump flow into the headspace, bed and any pressure storage, m³/s (0 during the drip).

storage_volume_m3.description: Charged upstream carrier volume C·P, m³ (zero without compliance).

cumulative_inlet_volume_m3.description: Cumulative carrier volume delivered by the pump, m³.

cumulative_outlet_volume_m3.description: Cumulative carrier volume leaving the basket, m³.

cumulative_vented_volume_m3.description: Cumulative carrier volume discharged through the stop vent, m³. Includes the instantaneous vent at the final-stop timestamp.

retained_volume_m3.description: Total retained carrier volume: headspace, wetted pore inventory and charged compliance storage, m³. Not an exact solvent-mass inventory.

beverage_mass_kg.description: Beverage mass in the cup, kg.

tds_cup.description: TDS of the cup so far (mass fraction).

tds_outlet.description: TDS of the extract leaving the basket now (mass fraction).

outlet_temp_c.description: Temperature of the extract leaving the basket (the lumped bed node), °C.

species_cup_kg.description: Cumulative cup mass of each tracked species, kg.

wetted_fraction.description: Wetted share of the bed volume.

SpeciesSeries.description: One species' cumulative cup mass over time.

values.description: Cup mass at each time, kg.

Spatial.description: Spatial state of the bed. Tier 0 reports its columns (three strata, one without spread, plus the edge annulus), 8 cells and two merged size classes.

depth_m.description: Depth of each cell centre below the bed top, m.

depth_edges_m.description: Depth of each cell face below the bed top, m (cells + 1 values, from 0 to the bed height).

columns.description: The parallel columns, from the centre outward.

snapshots.description: Snapshots spread over the shot (the last one at the end).

class_ey.description: Extraction yield of each size class at the end.

ColumnInfo.description: One parallel column (radial annulus or permeability stratum). Column i takes the fixed share f_i of the cross-section at every height: at height h it spans radii r(h)√F_{i−1} to r(h)√F_i, where F_i is the cumulative share and r(h) the wall radius, so A_i(z) = f_i·A(z).

inner_radius_m.description: Inner radius of the annulus at the floor, m.

outer_radius_m.description: Outer radius of the annulus at the floor, m.

Snapshot.description: Bed state at one instant; arrays are [column][depth cell].

local_ey.description: Local extraction yield of the solids in each cell: the net soluble loss of the cell's particles over their dry mass. Negative only where particles re-absorbed more than they lost (possible with solubles.kernel_loading_cap = false).

liquid_conc_kg_m3.description: Concentration of lumped solubles in the bed liquid (intergranular plus imbibed water), kg/m³ (0 where dry).

wetted_fraction.description: Wetted share of each cell: 0 dry, 1 wet, in between where the wetting front is.

ClassEy.description: Extraction yield of one size class: mass that left its particles over its dry mass.

hydraulic_volume_balance_error.description: Final relative carrier-liquid volume residual: supplied minus basket outflow, retained pore/headspace/compliance liquid and vented liquid, over supplied volume (0 without supply). This follows the incompressible hydraulic convention, not exact solvent mass including solute displacement or dissolution-created pore volume.

mass_balance_error.description: Relative error in the soluble mass balance (particles + liquid + cup): the largest over the run's check points, over the lumped solubles and every tracked species, each relative to its initial mass.

warnings.description: Human-readable warnings (e.g. choked shot, stop rule never fired, a spread the columns cannot represent, mass balance above 1e-9, a negative concentration).

min_concentration_kg_m3.description: Smallest concentration seen in any step (bed liquid, kernel shells and surface pools, lumped and species, each species at its own mass fraction), kg/m³; a positivity check.

tier.description: Fidelity tier that produced the result.

outflow_integral_error.description: Quadrature consistency of the outlet accounting: the relative difference between the cup's solute (the implicit outflow of every step) and the trapezoidal integral of outlet flow × outlet concentration at the step ends. Both integrate the same q·c, so it checks the bookkeeping of the outlet, not the bed; it is first order in the step (about 3e-3 at Δt = 0.05 s).

max_regime_solves.description: Most bed-liquid solves any column needed in one step (the policy iteration over pool regimes and caps; 1–3 is typical).

rejected_steps.description: Steps rejected and retried: a regime iteration that did not converge (retried at half the step) or a mass target overshot by more than 0.1 mg (re-landed).
